一段動詞（いちだんどうし）の「合（あ）わせる」（「併（あわ）せる」とも）の形（かたち）が変（か）わった「合（あ）わせて」は、「(A) に合（あ）うように」という意味（いみ）を表（あらわ）します。(A) には名詞（めいし）が入（はい）って、そのあとに格助詞（かくじょし）の「に」と「合（あ）わせて」が続（つづ）きます。この文法（ぶんぽう）は、(A) が基準（きじゅん）で、それに合（あ）うように (B) を変（か）えるようなときに使（つか）われます。

五段動詞（ごだんどうし）の「合（あ）う」を過去形（かこけい）にすると、「(A) に合（あ）った (B)」のように、(A) と (B) をつなぐことができます。

この表現（ひょうげん）が使（つか）われる文（ぶん）には、たいてい文（ぶん）の中（なか）に「(A) に合（あ）わせてどのようなことをするか」や「(A) と (B) はどのような関係（かんけい）か」などの情報（じょうほう）が含（ふく）まれています。

注意点（ちゅういてん）

「合わせて（あわせて）」は「(A) と同（おな）じ時（とき）に」や「(A) と一緒（いっしょ）に」という意味（いみ）で使（つか）われることもありますが、その場合（ばあい）も、(A) が (B) を動（うご）かす基準（きじゅん）になっていると考（かんが）えていいでしょう。
attributes.body:
When the る - Verb 合（あ）わせる (sometimes 併（あ）せる) is seen in the form 合（あ）わせて, it conveys that something has been made to 'match (A)' or 'fit with (A)'. (A) being a noun that appears before に, followed by 合（あ）わせて. This structure can also have the nuance of 'in accordance with (A)', highlighting that (A) is the governing factor.

It is also possible to see the う - Verb 合（あ）う used in its past tense form, linking an (A) noun to a (B) noun. This has a similar meaning, but is closer to '(B) that has met (A)'.

In sentences that use either of these expressions, more information is usually given about why something is happening in accordance with (A), or what the purpose of (B) meeting (A) is/was.

Caution

With 合（あ）わせて, sometimes the meaning is as simple as 'at the same time as (A)', or 'together with (A)'. However, (A) will still be perceived as being the primary cause/reason for whatever happens in the (B) part of the sentence.

attributes.body: Both express a general sense of basing an action on something, but their specific nuances differ. に合わせて・に合った conveys adapting or matching to something. For example: 季節に合わせて洋服を選ぶ = 'Choose clothes based on the season.' In contrast, にもとづいて typically expresses the grounding or foundation for some action. For example, 経験にもとづいて判断する = 'Make a decision based on experience.'

first_relatable.title: に合わせて・に合った
first_relatable.meaning: In accordance with, Matching, Fitting, Suitable for, Adjust or tune to

attributes.body: Both relate to the idea of being in accordance with something else, but with different nuances and usage. に合わせて・に合った follows a noun and implies adjustment to suit a person or situation, e.g. 相手に合わせて話し方を変える ('Adjust your way of speaking to the other person'), while にしたがって shows something happening in response or proportion to another change, e.g. 年を取るにしたがって体力が落ちる ('As you age, your stamina declines').

attributes.body: Both relate to the idea of being suited to something else, but with different nuances. に合わせて・に合った implies active adjustment to suit a person or situation, e.g. 季節に合わせて洋服を選ぶ ('Choose clothes to match the season'), while 向け describes being made for or targeted toward a certain group, e.g. 子供向けのアニメ ('A cartoon for children').

attributes.body: Both relate to the idea of one thing being dependent on another, but with different nuance and formality level. に応じて is a formal expression and conveys variation or response depending on conditions, e.g. 必要に応じてサポートする ('Support as needed'), while に合わせて・に合った is less formal and implies actively adjusting to match or suit something, e.g. 季節に合わせて洋服を選ぶ ('Choose clothes to match the season').
